honors.title: CSE Mission Award: Exceptional Project or Process Management
honors.description: The CVRP operations team received a CSE Mission Award for exceptional project or process management for client-driven efforts. We integrated the CRM and ERP systems for our project, which reduced our rebate check invoicing and fulfillment process from 3-4 days to 2-3 hours per batch.
honors.issuer: Issued by Center for Sustainable Energy · Dec 2014
